## Why This Is Asked

- Cross-lingual transfer and lightweight transformers

## Code Example

```python
# Pseudocode: simple federated averaging step
def federated_train(local_models, global_model):
    updates = [lm - global_model for lm in local_models]
    new_global = global_model + sum(updates)/len(updates)
    return new_global
```
